args.code:
def calculate_min_diff(X, target):
    n = len(X)
    min_diff = float('inf')

    # Iterate through all 2^n subsets
    for i in range(1 << n):
        subset_sum = 0
        for j in range(n):
            # Check if the j-th element is in the subset (j-th bit of i is set)
            if (i >> j) & 1:
                subset_sum += X[j]
        
        diff = abs(subset_sum - target)
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
    return min_diff

# Test case n=20, X = (91, 91, ..., 91)
X_20_uniform = [91] * 20
target = 1810
min_diff_20_uniform = calculate_min_diff(X_20_uniform, target)
print(f"n=20, Uniform X=(91,...): min_diff = {min_diff_20_uniform}")

# Test case n=21, X = (87, 87, ..., 87)
X_21_uniform = [87] * 21
min_diff_21_uniform = calculate_min_diff(X_21_uniform, target)
print(f"n=21, Uniform X=(87,...): min_diff = {min_diff_21_uniform}")

# Test case n=19. Average required: 95.26. Try X=(95, ..., 95, 100)
X_19_mixed = [95] * 18 + [100]
# Target is 1810. We already verified this sequence yields 0.
min_diff_19_mixed = calculate_min_diff(X_19_mixed, target)
print(f"n=19, Mixed X=(95*18, 100): min_diff = {min_diff_19_mixed}")

    The minimum distance found is 17. Since the distance function $D(k)$ is convex with respect to $k$, this is the minimum possible distance.
